summary: Iteration 5 — Re-verified the 'Add 100 rows below' empty-rows bug fix after main-agent's DB cleanup + defensive useRef/disabled-state guard. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases in test_bulk_empty_rows.py PASS (empty template -> null project/deliverable/stage; no template -> same; count 0/501 -> 400; member creator_id forced; non-empty template still honoured). Frontend Playwright as admin-1 with sticky localStorage context set to FAKE_STICKY_PROJECT/FAKE_STICKY_DELIVERABLE/Content: clicked bulk-add button, button became disabled=True with (attempted) label swap during in-flight, request completed, button re-enabled. Row count indicator moved 10 -> 210 across two clicks (+100 per click, exactly as expected). Screenshot confirms all newly-added rows render '—' in Project/Stage/Deliverable columns and 'Deliverable name' placeholder + Type placeholder + Core/v1/0/Unassigned/Not Started defaults; draft row (#+) at top still shows sticky-context prefill (Content stage) which is the intentional preserved behaviour for single-row inline add. Toast 'X rows added' appears. Second rapid click at 500ms interval was actionability-blocked while disabled, but subsequent clicks after re-enable land as expected — synchronous ref guard functions correctly (blocks true same-tick double-fire; not intended to block user's slower repeat clicks). Smoke tests: Dashboard, Projects, Team, Approvals, Clients all load without errors. Cleaned up all 200 empty test rows via /api/work-items/bulk-delete (DB back to 10 legitimate seed rows).
critical_code_review_comments: WorkSheetPage.handleBulkAddRows: bulkAddingRef synchronous guard is a good defensive addition; combined with bulkAdding state -> disabled button provides double-protection against accidental double-submit. No issues found.

Empty template `{}` correctly falls through to Pydantic defaults (work_category='Core', status='Not Started', project_id/deliverable_id/stage=None). Backend behaviour unchanged — fix is purely on frontend payload.
Draft row (single-row add) still uses localStorage sticky context — this is by-design and matches user expectation (bulk-add=empty, inline draft=continue previous context).
